h1: Custom Clear Plastic Cups with Your Logo
lead: Choose a clear plastic cup by its listed material, shape and serving capacity. Then develop your logo or pattern on that selected cup with a free design proposal and product mockup.

Use material-specific product information

Clear appearance does not make PET, PS, acrylic and other materials interchangeable. Use the model material and care information, rather than a category-wide heat or dishwasher claim.
